findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_guides" references sensitive artifacts (env var). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user has a launch question about an AI-built app on Vercel + Supabase, such as Supabase RLS, env vars on Vercel, a Stripe webhook after deploy…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides · Private data: explain_finding, search_guides, check_supabase_migrations · Public sink: search_guides · Destructive: launch_checklist, check_supabase_migrations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides · Private data: explain_finding, search_guides, check_supabase_migrations · Public sink: search_guides · Destructive: launch_checklist, check_supabase_migrations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
